tasks.notes: Instagram OAuth connect (/api/accounts/instagram/oauth/start|callback). Long-lived token, Fernet-encrypted, ig_user_id stored, webhook auto-subscribe. Token via query param for top-level redirect. Daily token refresh beat task.
Webhook GET verify + POST receive (/api/webhooks/instagram). X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC verify on raw body, immediate 200, enqueue Celery.
Rules CRUD + logs router with ownership checks. Pydantic cross-field validation (keywords/comment_action). AccountOut exposes ig_user_id + ig_webhook_subscribed.
Celery process_instagram_event + handle_match: loop protection, idempotency (ON CONFLICT), DM 200/h rate limit, 24h window, Graph API send (DM/public/private/both), retry only on 5xx.
